data.title: Creating a Non-Billable Timecard
data.intro: Follow these steps to create a non-billable timecard.

steps.title: Access the 'Create Ad Hoc Timecard' Option
steps.body: From the Timecards menu, select 'Create Ad Hoc Timecard'.

steps.title: Mark the Timecard as Non-Billable
steps.body: In the timecard creation form, mark the timecard as non-billable.

steps.title: Add a Comment Explaining the Non-Billable Status
steps.body: Include a comment detailing why the timecard is marked as non-billable.

steps.title: Submit for Facility Review
steps.body: Submit the timecard for facility review to finalize the process.
